newsitem.title: JAPAN: TSE to announce S'tomo Seika outstanding volume.
newsitem.headline: TSE to announce S'tomo Seika outstanding volume.

text.p: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) said on Wednesday it would announce the outstanding volume of margin trade in shares of Sumitomo Seika Chemicals Co Ltd, starting with orders placed on September 25.
The exchange sometimes discloses information on margin trade in certain shares that are volatile as a precautionary measure for investors.
In Wednesday's session, the shares rose 37 yen to 950 yen in volume of 9.474 million shares, the second-largest on the first section of the TSE.
